title: Gato Waton
description: the chonkiest boy in da earth :O
body:
This mod adds a new mod, a **Chonky Cat (based on a plush!)** It can be tamed with cookies, they will be your new companion and your best friend!!

Nothing to add, just chonkyness

![The model of the boye](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acbbc8838ea70a317ed30fcefec6c9c38049a382.gif)
